title: agent-kit's data in an extension's plugin.json
description: What goes under metadata["agent-kit"] in a Claude Code plugin's .claude-plugin/plugin.json, for agent-kit's gates, chats and catalog. Claude Code doesn't read metadata. Every field is optional.

kit.description: The agent-kit versions it works with: comparators separated by spaces, all of which must hold (">=0.22.0", ">=0.22.0 <0.24.0").

description.description: Its description in other languages than English, which stays plugin.json's own description (Claude Code reads that one).

provides.description: Capabilities it lets the agent use, by name only. Its capabilities' ids count as provided too.

capabilities.description: What it lets the agent do, for the person: each one's skills and tools together, described per language. Its id is what requires names; neutral ids (lms-grading) let skills depend on what can be done, not on which extension does it.

requires.description: Capabilities another enabled extension must provide.

requirements.description: Programs it needs on the computer, which the person installs: agent-kit checks them, says what's missing and how to install it, and never installs them. Without one the whole extension needs, it's off; without one only some capabilities need (for), those are.

readOnlyTools.description: Its tools that only read (short names): plan mode lets them through. Without it, plan mode asks its servers (readOnlyHint).

confirmTools.description: Its tools that always ask the person in guided mode (short names), even inside a batch they approved, and are never offered "always": what creates, edits or publishes in their account. Without it, its servers' destructiveHint says which.

labels.description: How the chat shows each tool (short name), per language (en, es, fr, de): {field} takes the call's input.

phrase.description: How it counts in a folded summary: once, and {n} times.

help.description: What it says about itself in a session, for the agent to tell the person.

catalog.description: How a catalog shows it: images inside its folder (SVG, PNG, JPEG or WebP).

program.description: Its bare name, found on the PATH (on Windows with PATHEXT's extensions): never a path.

version.description: How to check its version: run with these arguments only (options or version, no shell), the first x.y.z it prints compared with min.

install.description: How to install it on each system: a command, or a link (url, the fallback).

for.description: The capabilities (ids it provides) that need it; without it, the whole extension does.

skills.description: Its skills, by their folder in the extension's skills/.

tools.description: Its tools, by short name (of any of its servers).

texts.description: Its label and description per language (en, es, fr, de); English is shown where its language is missing.
